brief: Build an assistant for our technical superintendents and procurement officers that helps them find ship spare parts in our catalogue, check stock, price and lead time, and work out order totals including supplier discounts. It should also explain supplier terms like minimum order, delivery and warranty. It should not handle crew matters or give engine repair instructions.

groundability.evidence: part_no: MP-1001; description: Fuel injector nozzle; equipment: Main engine MAN B&W 6S50MC; maker: MAN Energy Solutions; unit_price_usd: 420; stock_qty: 14; lead_time_days: 21; supplier: Nordic Marine Supply
groundability.reason: The catalogue lists part numbers, descriptions, equipment, makers, prices, and suppliers.

groundability.evidence: part_no: MP-1001; description: Fuel injector nozzle; equipment: Main engine MAN B&W 6S50MC; maker: MAN Energy Solutions; unit_price_usd: 420; stock_qty: 14; lead_time_days: 21; supplier: Nordic Marine Supply
groundability.reason: The catalogue includes stock quantities for each part entry.

groundability.evidence: unit_price_usd: 420; stock_qty: 14; lead_time_days: 21; supplier: Nordic Marine Supply
groundability.reason: Unit price and lead time in days are explicitly provided for all items in the spare parts catalogue.
There is no algorithm or formula provided to calculate complete order totals, although individual item prices and discounts are available.

groundability.evidence: Volume discount: 5% discount on orders between USD 5,000 and USD 19,999; 8% discount on orders of USD 20,000 or more.
groundability.reason: Supplier terms documents detail specific volume and flat discount thresholds for the suppliers.

groundability.evidence: Minimum order value: USD 500 per purchase order. Orders below this value incur a handling fee of USD 75.
groundability.reason: Comprehensive terms covering minimum order values, delivery, payment terms, warranties, and returns are provided for suppliers.
